opening.argument: The central offer is a direct deposit-for-double arrangement, not merely market commentary. Viewers are instructed that "you simply send a deposit to that address" and that, after blockchain confirmation, the system "automatically sends back double the amount to the same wallet." The speaker presents this as a community benefit, describing it as "a gesture of appreciation to the community" and an opportunity to double viewers' crypto holdings. The solicitation is also time-limited: "it's a one-time opportunity only available during this live stream," followed by an instruction to act without hesitation. Those specific promises, combined with the pressure to participate immediately, establish a low-barrier offer to acquire a reward or asset through sending cryptocurrency; the market-analysis visuals do not alter that central solicitation.
